He slipped the note into his coat pocket, climbed the spiral stair, and that night kept the light burning a little brighter than duty required.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市睡得最沉。路灯把空荡的街道照成一条发黄的河，偶尔有出租车低声驶过，像梦里翻身的呼吸。早点铺的卷帘门半开，蒸笼冒出第一缕白雾，老人揉着面，手上沾着凉意。天边泛起极淡的青灰，星子还没退尽。清洁工的扫帚沙沙响，一只流浪猫蹲在墙角，眼睛亮得像两粒露水。这座白天喧嚣的城市，此刻把自己交给了寂静，仿佛在积攒气力，等待又一次苏醒。", "w03": "• Imagine standing between two mirrors—you see yourself, holding a picture of yourself, holding another picture, again and again.\n• Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a smaller version of the same problem, over and over.\n• It stops when the problem gets so tiny there's an easy answer—like counting down to zero and shouting 'done!'"}
